title: NASDAQ-Adv: 1,815 Dec: 1,200 NYSE-Adv: 1,633 Dec: 1,363 (So
text:
NASDAQ-Adv: 1,815 Dec: 1,200 NYSE-Adv: 1,633 Dec: 1,363 (Source: Nasdaq)
U.S. stocks ended slightly higher on Monday as gains in Apple (AAPL.O) and other tech shares helped offset a slump in energy as well as concerns about an escalating trade war between Washington and its trading partners.
Based on the latest available data, the Dow Jones Industrial Average .DJI rose 35.77 points, or 0.15 percent, to 24,307.18, the S&P 500 .SPX gained 8.34 points, or 0.31 percent, to 2,726.71 and the Nasdaq Composite .IXIC added 57.38 points, or 0.76 percent, to 7,567.69.
Source: Reuters (Reporting by Caroline Valetkevitch; and editing by Jonathan Oatis)
